top_signals.title: Stocks Gain as Microsoft Results Ease AI Worries: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stocks rose as strong growth at Microsoft Corp. reassured investors that expensive bets on AI are starting to pay off, outweighing resurgent worries about inflation that are pummeling long-dated bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Pakistan Secures Safe Passage for LNG Shipment With Iran Deal
top_signals.summary: Pakistan has negotiated with Iran to secure safe passage for at least one Qatari liquefied natural gas shipment, according to people with knowledge of the matter, the latest effort by the South Asian nation to use its diplomatic ties to ease a deepening energy crunch.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Sen. John Cornyn, R-Texas, says the DOJ has failed to satisfy his concerns about a deal to shield President Donald Trump and others from IRS tax audits.
